name: MidoriVPN
summary: Route browser traffic through the authenticated MidoriVPN proxy.

description.en: MidoriVPN protects browser traffic through a user-selected HTTPS CONNECT gateway. Sign in with PKCE, select a healthy server, and explicitly enable protection. Scoped proxy credentials are short lived, OAuth tokens are encrypted locally, and routing fails closed if protection cannot be restored.
description.es: MidoriVPN protege el tráfico del navegador mediante un gateway HTTPS CONNECT elegido por el usuario. Inicia sesión con PKCE, selecciona un servidor saludable y activa la protección. Las credenciales del proxy son de corta duración, los tokens OAuth se cifran localmente y la ruta falla de forma segura si no puede restaurarse.

single_purpose: Provide an authenticated VPN proxy for traffic generated by this browser.

permission_justifications.alarms: Schedules bounded OAuth token refresh and connection recovery work.
permission_justifications.storage: Stores settings, selected server, encrypted session values, and fail-closed state.
permission_justifications.proxy: Configures the browser HTTPS proxy selected and enabled by the user.
permission_justifications.tabs: Closes the OAuth callback tab after success or failure and opens the explicit permission flow.
permission_justifications.webRequest: Receives proxy authentication challenges; request content is not inspected or retained.
permission_justifications.webNavigation: Detects only the configured OAuth callback URL to complete PKCE login.
permission_justifications.webRequestAuthProvider: Supplies a short-lived vpn-proxy credential to Chromium proxy challenges.
permission_justifications.webRequestBlocking: Supplies a short-lived vpn-proxy credential to Firefox proxy challenges.
permission_justifications.<all_urls>: The browser proxy must protect user-requested HTTPS destinations across sites. URLs and page content are not logged by the extension.

data_use.purpose: Authentication identifies the subscriber, the account name/email is displayed in the popup, and browsing destinations necessarily transit the selected VPN proxy to provide the advertised service.

test_instructions: Load the package, select Sign in with Astian, complete PKCE with an authorized test account, choose a server advertising a healthy proxy transport, enable the VPN switch, and confirm browser egress changes. Disable the switch and confirm direct egress returns. Reviewer credentials are managed outside the repository.
